items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I know the fellow Red Baptiste, I see him at football games too.

ctx.x: Did he have any family that you know of? Who's that? Red Baptiste. I don't know any of his people.

I just knew him from having a place up there. And having a- Now, around in that section, if you could inquire around there, maybe somebody knows people. Somebody up there would know. I never lived uptown. The only way I went up there is after a dance, we would go up that way to get a breakfast in the morning. You see, and they used to sell, they used to serve some nice breakfast up in that section, you see. And we used to go up that way and eat. And then we would come back down in our section. But the bum up…
It's possible this picture would be someplace here, I hope. Hard to run down any good pictures usually. Very few musicians kept scrapbooks.
